reason: The monotonicity conclusion would be valid for genuine operator-space matrix norms and the standard amplification, but those hypotheses are not among this node's allowed inputs. def-hcb-datum only packages an extended epsilon-C*-algebra, compressed corners, amplified column spaces, and sesquilinear forms, and expressly says it is data/notation only; it does not state Ruan's direct-sum/scalar-multiplication axioms, that zero-corner embeddings M_n tensor S_P -> M_m tensor S_P are isometries, or that the amplified operator targets admit the corresponding isometric zero-corner embeddings. None of the other registered definitions supplies these facts, and the two permitted upstream lemmas concern adjointness and product defect, not matrix-norm functoriality. Thus the asserted equalities of both domain and target norms under zero padding are hidden unsupported assumptions, so restricting the infimum at level m to the embedded level-n subspace does not establish a_m <= a_n from the allowed dependencies.
